---
title: "`r params$title`"
author: "`r params$author`"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%Y-%m-%d')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    number_sections: true
    self_contained: true
params:
  results_rds: null
  title: Population genomics analysis
  author: ""
  figures: null
  report_format: html
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE)
r <- readRDS(params$results_rds)
if (inherits(r, "PopgenVCFAnalysis")) {
  a <- r
  r <- c(
    list(
      metadata = a$samples$metadata,
      qc_snps = a$variants$qc_ids,
      final_snps = a$variants$ld_ids,
      qc = a$variants$reports
    ),
    a$results
  )
}
report_figures <- params$figures
html_escape <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('"', "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}
report_table_section <- function(title, table, digits = NULL, level = 1L) {
  if (is.null(table)) return(invisible(FALSE))
  cat(strrep("#", level), " ", title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(knitr::kable(table, digits = digits), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n\n")
  invisible(TRUE)
}
```

# Executive summary

This `r toupper(params$report_format)` file is a portable, human-readable
analysis report. Figures are embedded directly in the file. The HTML version
can be opened in a standard web browser, while the PDF version is optimized for
compact exchange, printing, and email. The accompanying `analysis_results.rds`
file is a reproducibility archive for
R users; it is not required to read this report.

The analysis retained **`r nrow(r$metadata)` samples** from **`r data.table::uniqueN(r$metadata$population)` populations**, with **`r length(r$qc_snps)` QC-passing SNPs** and **`r length(r$final_snps)` LD-pruned SNPs**.

```{r analysis-sections, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(r$fst$global) && length(r$fst$global) &&
    is.finite(r$fst$global[[1L]])) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "The global Weir-Cockerham $F_{ST}$ estimate was **%.4f**.\n\n",
    r$fst$global[[1L]]
  ))
}
report_table_section("Quality control", r$qc$sequential, digits = 2)
report_table_section("Genetic diversity", r$diversity$population, digits = 4)
report_table_section(
  "Principal component analysis",
  if (!is.null(r$pca$scores)) head(r$pca$scores, 20) else NULL,
  digits = 4
)
report_table_section("Population differentiation", r$fst$long, digits = 4)
report_table_section(
  "Discriminant analysis of principal components",
  r$dapc$diagnostics,
  digits = 4
)
if (!is.null(r$amova)) {
  cat("# Analysis of molecular variance\n\n")
  if (!is.null(r$amova$components)) {
    cat(knitr::kable(r$amova$components, digits = 4), sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  }
  if (!is.null(r$amova$phi)) {
    cat(knitr::kable(r$amova$phi, digits = 4), sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
report_table_section(
  "Mantel test and isolation by distance", r$ibd$summary, digits = 4
)
report_table_section(
  "Admixture-model cross-validation", r$admixture_cv, digits = 6
)
report_table_section(
  "Chromosome-specific results", r$chromosome_summary, digits = 4
)
```

# Figure gallery

The gallery contains one version of every analysis figure. The HTML report
prefers browser-friendly SVG or PNG files. The PDF report prefers the compact
vector PDF source for each figure. Original files remain available in the
sibling `figures/` directory.

```{r figure-gallery, results='asis'}
if (is.null(report_figures) || !nrow(report_figures)) {
  cat("No figure files were found. Configure `output.figure_formats` to include `pdf`, `png`, or `svg`, then regenerate the report.\n")
} else if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(report_figures))) {
    figure <- report_figures[i, , drop = FALSE]
    caption <- html_escape(figure$caption[[1L]])
    filename <- html_escape(basename(figure$path[[1L]]))
    uri <- knitr::image_uri(figure$path[[1L]])
    if (identical(figure$format[[1L]], "pdf")) {
      cat(sprintf(
        paste0(
          '<figure style="margin:2em 0">',
          '<figcaption><strong>%s</strong><br><small>%s</small></figcaption>',
          '<p><a href="%s" target="_blank">Open the embedded PDF figure</a></p>',
          '</figure>\n'
        ),
        caption, filename, uri
      ))
    } else {
      cat(sprintf(
        paste0(
          '<figure style="margin:2em 0">',
          '<img src="%s" alt="%s" loading="lazy" ',
          'style="display:block;max-width:100%%;height:auto;margin:auto">',
          '<figcaption style="text-align:center;margin-top:0.5em">',
          '<strong>%s</strong><br><small>%s</small></figcaption>',
          '</figure>\n'
        ),
        uri, caption, caption, filename
      ))
    }
  }
} else {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(report_figures))) {
    figure <- report_figures[i, , drop = FALSE]
    caption <- figure$caption[[1L]]
    path <- gsub(" ", "%20", figure$path[[1L]], fixed = TRUE)
    cat(sprintf(
      "![%s](%s){width=95%%}\n\n\\newpage\n\n",
      caption, path
    ))
  }
}
```

# Reproducibility

This report was generated from the serialized pipeline result object. Exact input hashes, settings, package versions, and stage runtimes are stored alongside the report.

```{r reproducibility-sections, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(r$dapc) && "replicate_max_rmse" %in% names(r$dapc$diagnostics)) {
  report_table_section(
    "Population-structure reproducibility",
    r$dapc$diagnostics[, c("K", "assignment_accuracy", "replicate_max_rmse")],
    digits = 4, level = 2L
  )
}
if (!is.null(r$faststructure$runs)) {
  report_table_section("fastStructure", r$faststructure$runs, level = 2L)
}
if (!is.null(r$snmf$diagnostics)) {
  report_table_section(
    "Sparse non-negative matrix factorization",
    r$snmf$diagnostics,
    digits = 6, level = 2L
  )
}
```
